introduction: Read Chapter 26 and its written lab. Six bounded experiments connect active windows, motion, prediction, transform representations and final reconstruction. Use inline predictions and ordinary Debug at named boundaries. Only the continuing independent reconstruction function is unfinished.
conclusion: Explain each representation and admitted window, then implement final signed reconstruction with complete validation and exact alias behavior. Numerical observations do not establish inverse accuracy over all inputs or whole-stream interoperability; the following stream unit has its own verification.
